items.title: File Einspruch against the Vollstreckungsbescheid
items.quote: Rechtsbehelf: Sie können sich mit einem Einspruch wehren. Er ist schriftlich beim Amtsgericht Beispielaue einzulegen, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen; die Frist beginnt mit der Zustellung und ist eine Notfrist.
items.computation: The letter itself states the delivery (Zustellung) date: 'am 23.11.2026 in den Briefkasten eingelegt.' This is a court service, not an authority's deemed-delivery post, so the stated date is used directly as the start of the period (§ 180 ZPO). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (23.11.2026, a Monday) is not counted; the two-week Notfrist (§ 339 Abs. 1, § 700 Abs. 1 ZPO) runs from 24.11.2026 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the second week bearing the same name as the starting day, i.e. Monday 07.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in Sachsen (no shift needed under § 222 Abs. 1, 2 ZPO).

warnings: This is a Vollstreckungsbescheid: the claimant can already start enforcement (Zwangsvollstreckung) even though it is not yet final, and the two-week Einspruch period is a strict court deadline (Notfrist) that cannot be extended — act quickly and consider getting legal advice.

No explicit payment deadline is stated in the letter beyond the total being enforceable now; the total 317,50 EUR (270,00 Hauptforderung + 6,30 Zinsen + 41,20 Verfahrenskosten) is already titled and can be collected by enforcement at any time.

The underlying Mahnbescheid of 16.10.2026 is stated to have been served and unopposed; if the person never actually received that earlier Mahnbescheid, this is an important fact to raise immediately, ideally within the Einspruch.
